description: Changes one block on the registration or thank-you page of a webinar: its text or its image. Take it when a single box on the page is wrong and the rest should stay. A host says: "The second box still says last year, change just that one." It needs the session, the webinar, the place of the block as the page lists it, and the new text or the new image. It writes on your site, participants see it on their next visit, and nothing else on the page moves. A block with its own formatting never loses it silently: when the spot is not clear, the site refuses and writes nothing. The answer carries the previous block, so the same call puts it back. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: one box on the page, edit a block, swap the image, page text

confirm.description: Only after the site answered code admin_editing: the host agreed to overwrite unsaved changes in wp-admin.

image_alt.description: The alt text of the new image.

image_id.description: The media library id of the new image, if you have it.

image_url.description: The new image address for an image block.

path.description: The block path, exactly as wi_get_webinar_page_blocks returned it.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

surface.description: Which page the block stands on. Default registration.

text.description: The new text for a text block: paragraph, heading, list item, quote or button.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_page_block
title: Change one block on a webinar page
